_about: Design tokens for Naarad Discover. Roles are stable, values come from three places: Naarad's own rendered page (measured in Chromium at 1440x900), Brand Kit v1.0 (printed hex values) and the pitch deck (sampled from pixels). replica/brand-review.md says which value came from where and where the three disagree. Nothing here records Komoot's colours, fonts or sizes: replica/screens-notes.md lists the original's colours for reference only. Where a brand value fails WCAG AA the token holds a text-safe companion and `_brand` says why. Regenerate tokens.css with: python3 replica/design/build-tokens.py. Check with: python3 .claude/skills/replica-design/contrast.py replica/design/tokens.json

_legacy._about: What Naarad's Discover ships today, measured from the rendered page, and what the token changes. Use this when wiring tokens into index.html in replica-build.
_legacy.text: live #1A1A2E in filter bar and cards, #172752 in chips. Unified to the palette navy #172752.
_legacy.text-muted: live #6B6B7B (5.2:1 on white, 4.9:1 on the sheet). Token #4A5068 is the site's --txm and is stronger, and removes one grey.
_legacy.border-input: live chip border #B8BEC9 is 1.9:1 on white, below the 3:1 a control boundary needs. Token is 3.7:1.
_legacy.accent: live #E8641A (3.35:1 as text, and under white labels) and --terra #DD6E27 (3.32:1). Token #B35920 is the same hue darkened until white-on and text-on both pass 4.5:1.
_legacy.accent-bright: the brand terracotta #DD6E27, for slider thumbs, selected-card borders and the active tab line only: graphics need 3:1, not 4.5:1. Never for text.
_legacy.success/warning/danger: the intended difficulty pill colours at index.html line 330 (6.4 to 6.8:1). A later duplicate rule at line 1302 overrides them on Discover cards with #4ade80, #fb923c and #f87171 on a 20% wash: 1.5, 1.9 and 2.1:1. The tokens restore the intended pair.
_legacy.route-*: new. Naarad draws each GPX track in an arbitrary colour. 3 of the 8 fail 4.5:1 under white 11px text (#16A34A, #EA580C, #0891B2).
_legacy.map-bg: ASSUMED. The tile source is undecided (see architecture.md), so this is a typical light base-map tone, not a measurement. Re-check the route-* pairs when a tile source is chosen.
_legacy.type.label: live chips and section heads are 10px uppercase with 1.5 to 2px tracking. Token is 12px so nothing in Discover is below 12px.
_legacy.type.sm: live filter-bar text is 12.5px, rating is 11.5px, badges 11px. Snapped to 12 and 14.
_legacy.radius.sharp: live chips are 2px (editorial). Live cards are 14px, the sheet 20px, badges 50px.
_legacy.layout: live Discover is a full-width bottom sheet over the map at EVERY width, so on a 1440px screen each card is 1416px wide. The token layout.split (900px) is the target: a 380px list column beside the map at 900px and up, the bottom sheet below it.

_brand._about: What changed when the brand kit and deck were applied, and what was deliberately not taken from them.
_brand.bg: #F6F0E6 is the deck's paper cream (sampled #F4EEE3 to #F7F1E9). Before: #FAF8F2.
_brand.sand: #F2E8DB, the kit's Sand (printed). Tags, and the card media when a route has no photo.
_brand.accent: #A7542A is the deck's burnt sienna (sampled). It passes as text (4.6 on cream, 5.3 on white) and carries a white label (5.3). The kit's Heritage Orange cannot do either (3.06). Before: #B35920. Not used as text on Sand (4.4, just under AA): Sand holds tags and card media, never sienna text.
_brand.accent-bright: #E0621B is the kit orange darkened about 6% so it reaches 3:1 on the cream sheet (the kit's own #F26A1C is 2.5 on Sand). Graphics only: slider thumbs, the selected-card ring, the rating star. Before: #DD6E27.
_brand.orange: #F26A1C, the kit's Heritage Orange (printed), as a fill only, with a navy label (on-orange). The kit's white-on-orange secondary button is 3.06 and fails the deck's own WCAG 2.1 AA commitment, so it is not used.
_brand.forest: #1E5B46, the kit's Forest Green (printed). Easy routes, success, the active state of the Map/list switch.
_brand.success: Was #166534. Now the kit's forest, so easy routes and success share one green.
_brand.not taken: Cinzel (kit headings: it has no lowercase, and the deck and site use Playfair Display). The kit's navy #0B1D3A (the site's navy bar above Discover is #172752, and the deck matches the site). Mustard #D99A2B (2.4 on white). The deck's yellow banner and sage (both under 3:1 as graphics). See replica/brand-review.md, section 1.
